summary: 2026-27 season. The club's official sponsors-and-partners page lists 15 club-level partners for 2026/27 (RZD, Krasnodar Krai Administration, Sirius federal territory, Olimpbet, Rosa Khutor, Radisson Collection, Yamaguchi, Sirius Educational Centre, Sirius Autodrom, Sochi24, the Leopard Restoration Centre, Skypark, Dodo Pizza, Sochi Park and Legenda); all are included as partners. The separate league-partner strip (Fonbet, Sogaz, T-Bank, Mir, Rostelecom, AvtoVAZ, Kinopoisk, Gislaved, Haier, S7) is league-level and covered by the KHL deals. Shirt placements are not documented: no kit-launch report was found and jersey pages do not describe sponsor logos.
